decisions.reason: The evening day-patient program builds on the core psychiatric offer and has its own page, and it required staffing and regulatory investment, so management will persist and treat slow uptake as a start-up effect.
The carpentry workshop uses invested equipment, has its own page and serves the firm's participation mission, so management will justify keeping it despite modest commercial results.
Outpatient sociotherapy fits the announced outpatient direction and is reimbursable, but its low visibility leaves some risk that it is quietly folded back into existing services.
The senior living counseling service is shown on the home page, which signals strong public commitment and centrality to eldercare, and its low running cost makes continuation very likely.
The retail shop supports inclusion goals and builds on sunk workshop investment, but its low visibility and real operating costs make it the most vulnerable product.

The meal delivery service is newly launched, so disappointing early results can still be attributed to start-up causes, and it fits the eldercare direction even though it is only mentioned on the website.
